title: RIFT Phase 3.5O — Reproducibility Checklist

tier_1_python_only.label: Tier 1 — Python-only validation
requires: Python 3.11 (CPython; pyproject.toml requires >=3.10, Makefile defaults to python3.11)

tier_2_full_testbed.label: Tier 2 — Full live testbed
requires: Docker Compose >= v2.24 (plugin, 'docker compose' syntax — NOT 'docker-compose')
Git (for HEAD SHA in build labels)
10 GB free disk (image pulls: ~3 GB boutique + ~1 GB observability)
tier_2_full_testbed.expected: All 15 services healthy; boutique-frontend at :8080, prometheus at :9090, jaeger at :16686
tier_2_full_testbed.intervention_test_command: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --cap-add NET_ADMIN rift-eval python3.11 -m pytest tests/integration/intervention/ -v
tier_2_full_testbed.e2e_command: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run rift-eval python3.11 -m src.rift.pipeline.e2e_runner --scenario NL_01
tier_2_full_testbed.e2e_expected: RIFTRunRecord JSON artifact written to artifacts/phase3/

explicit_macos_statement: macOS cannot execute live tc/netem network interventions. The tc/netem mechanism requires a Linux kernel >= 4.9 with CAP_NET_ADMIN and the sch_netem module. Docker Desktop on macOS does not grant NET_ADMIN to guest containers by default. All intervention tests on macOS are dry-run only and are marked PARTIAL in PHASE_3_MANIFEST.json (component 3G_3H_intervention). Do not claim cross-platform support for live intervention.
phase3_manifest_python_version_note: PHASE_3_MANIFEST.json records python_version=3.9.6 (the system Python of the development machine). This predates the requires-python>=3.10 constraint in pyproject.toml. Reproducers must use Python 3.11 as specified in the Makefile and ENVIRONMENT.md.
blocking_requirement: Linux host with kernel >= 4.9 and CAP_NET_ADMIN

3W_independent_validation.status: PARTIAL — oracle PAG; live testbed deferred to Phase 10

known_issues.title: macOS: tc commands are dry-run only
known_issues.mitigation: Run intervention tests on a Linux host or inside Docker on Linux

known_issues.title: Python version discrepancy: manifest records 3.9.6, project requires >=3.10
known_issues.mitigation: Use Python 3.11 as specified in Makefile and ENVIRONMENT.md

known_issues.title: Prometheus may not scrape gRPC-only boutique services
known_issues.mitigation: OpenTelemetry Collector adaptation deferred to Phase 10

known_issues.title: boutique-loadgen may fail if frontend not ready at startup
known_issues.mitigation: Wait 30s after docker compose up before expecting load; restart loadgen if needed

known_issues.title: CAP_NET_ADMIN must be explicitly granted for tc tests
known_issues.mitigation: The rift-eval service in docker-compose.yml already declares cap_add: [NET_ADMIN]; for standalone docker run, pass --cap-add NET_ADMIN

tier_1.item: make lint passes (no forbidden causal-claim phrases)

tier_2.item: Docker Compose v2 plugin (docker compose version)
Build args exported (BUILD_DATE, GIT_SHA, HOST_KERNEL, HOST_OS)
Network intervention tests pass (make test-intervention inside container)
E2E pipeline run produces RIFTRunRecord JSON artifact
